mapper.select: SELECT n.note_id AS noteId, n.semester_label AS semesterLabel, n.display_name AS displayName, n.user_id AS userId, (n.user_id IS NOT NULL) AS isMember, n.content, n.ink, n.paper, n.tilt, n.state, n.created_at AS createdAt FROM guestbook_notes n WHERE n.semester_label = #{semester} ORDER BY n.note_id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT semester_label FROM guestbook_notes ORDER BY semester_label DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guestbook_stickers (name, file_url, file_type, sort_order, created_by) VALUES (#{s.name}, #{s.fileUrl}, #{s.fileType}, #{s.sortOrder}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE guestbook_stickers SET state = 'deleted' WHERE sticker_id = #{stickerId} AND state = 'normal'
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(sort_order) FROM guestbook_stickers WHERE state = 'normal'
